description:
How did Spinosaurus go from one of the strangest dinosaurs ever discovered to an entirely different-looking predator? What makes Leonardo the best-preserved dinosaur ever found? And how can scientists discover 20,000 dinosaur footprints hidden in the Alps? From bizarre discoveries to shocking scientific mistakes, these dinosaur mysteries reveal just how much we still don't know about the prehistoric world.
